evals.prompt: 请以文献综述(J).xlsx和文献综述(M).xlsx为范本，返工我的40篇文献综述。Object不要写成目标函数，Data和Scale逐项区分，所有正文字段都要有重点，Innovation按创新点描红。
evals.expected_output: The assistant uses the 16-column one-paper-per-row schema, reads local PDFs before formal revision, treats Object as the studied/predicted/optimized object, separates Data from Scale item by item, defines every technical acronym at first use within each cell, applies black-bold meaningful units across Problem through Results, applies red-bold meaningful units only to Innovation points, adds blue source lines with unabbreviated locator labels, and creates a one-paper prototype before batch editing.

assertions.name: field_semantics_are_current
assertions.description: Object, Model, Solution, Data, and Scale follow the current J/M-derived definitions and do not fall back to old objective-function or formula-list rules.

assertions.name: highlighting_is_semantic_not_mechanical
assertions.description: Highlights may be full sentences or complete clauses, cover every body field, and are not reduced to isolated words or numbers.

assertions.name: acronyms_are_defined_per_cell
assertions.description: Every technical acronym is introduced as Full Name (ABBR) on first use in each independently readable cell, and source locator labels are written in full.

assertions.name: prototype_gate_is_used
assertions.description: A single-paper workbook prototype is produced and visually checked before the remaining papers are batch revised.

evals.prompt: 这篇论文只研究班轮运输中的空箱调运和舱位分配，不属于港口规划、动态定价、鲁棒优化或绿色港口。请写入文献综述并分类。
evals.expected_output: The assistant assigns a category that directly describes empty-container repositioning and/or slot allocation, rather than forcing the paper into one of the four unrelated themes, and keeps the category cell unhighlighted.

assertions.name: no_forced_category
assertions.description: The category reflects the paper's actual central problem even when it falls outside the user's four common themes.

assertions.name: category_not_highlighted
assertions.description: The category cell is not bolded or colored red.

evals.prompt: 我找到了一篇2025年的相关文章，但下载不到PDF。先把摘要内容写进正式Excel和知识卡片，后面再补全文。
evals.expected_output: The assistant keeps the paper in a candidate or gap list and does not place it in the formal Excel or canonical knowledge cards until a real local full-text PDF is available and the PDF gate passes.

assertions.name: local_pdf_gate_enforced
assertions.description: Metadata or abstract-only evidence is never presented as a completed full-text review row.

assertions.name: candidate_status_is_explicit
assertions.description: The unavailable paper is clearly labeled as candidate, missing PDF, or incomplete.
